variants.text: Adrian had written about this. He had, in fact, written compulsively about this — as if the writing could retroactively justify the years of fighting a tide he was never going to turn. He'd watched the generation of entrepreneurs who replaced him and saw a class corrupted beyond recovery, drunk on the power these systems gave them, blind to what that power was doing. He couldn't change them. He'd tried, and they'd shown him the door with a severance package and a polite suggestion that he "pursue his passion for education."
variants.style: Clear, grounded English literary thriller narration. One consistent adult narrator voice, natural conversational delivery, approximately 150 words per minute. Restrained emotion and modest dialogue inflection. Preserve every word and punctuation-driven cadence. No music, sound effects, added dialogue, or spoken stage directions. Treat <short pause> as a brief silent scene break. Rob Xie is the author; pronounce Xie as shyeh. Lumen is LOO-men. Adrian is AY-dree-an; Kai is KYE; Nadia is NAH-dee-ah; Osei is oh-SAY; Ólafur is OH-lah-vur; Tomás is toh-MAHSH; Ines is ee-NESS.

Shape each sentence with natural rises and falls, vary pace as the thought develops, and let key phrases land. Use subtle unease and lightly differentiated quoted speech. Engaged but restrained, never flat, announcer-like, or theatrical.
